title: Decision Algorithms for Ostrowski-Automatic Sequences
notes: MMath thesis, University of Waterloo, advisor Shallit. Theorem 2.2 is the 4-input Ostrowski adder with states (r,s) in {-1,0,1}^2. Section 5.3, pp. 49-50, defines the order-m Gamma-system and proposes an adder with m-dimensional states. Chapters 2 and 5 were written for the TCS 858 paper. This project does not claim the m-dimensional carry idea.
